Kodak 7222 Double-X for black and white, ~$40/100ft, it's the one people
have actually shot for sixty years. Vision3 50D if there's daylight and
money.

Buy short ends when they show up. Refrigerate.

summary: Double-X for black and white, Vision3 50D for daylight, buy short ends and refrigerate
